name: BMW M57D30 (530d)
notes: A verified real-world swap into an LJ78 used a 2003 E39 530d donor (see cataloged build). Distinct from the gas M52B28 already seeded - shares BMW's period bellhousing family but is a turbodiesel, not gas. Common-rail with its own ECU/DDE - that real build kept the donor's intact harness/ECU/pedal for exactly this reason.
